scripts.build: bun --bun vite build && bun run build:scripts && bun run build:bundle
scripts.build:scripts: bun build scripts/setup-schema.ts scripts/bulk-load.ts scripts/compact.ts scripts/backfill-descendants.ts scripts/reload-users.ts --target=bun --external shard-db --outdir=build/scripts
scripts.build:bundle: bun build build/index.js --target=bun --outdir build --external shard-db --external node-gyp-build && rm -rf build/server build/env.js build/handler.js && mkdir -p build/node_modules && cp -rL node_modules/shard-db node_modules/node-gyp-build build/node_modules/
